name: Survey tile in Sagittarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Sagittarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-04-18, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
